chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Zayd narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: I heard him saying:

A man from the descendants of Mūsā, whose name is the name of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, will emerge. He will be buried in the land of Ṭūs, and it is from Khurāsān. He will be killed there by poison and buried there as a stranger. So whoever visits him while recognizing his right, Allah, Mighty and Exalted, will grant him the reward of one who spent before the Victory and fought.

key_terms.أَرْضِ طُوسَ: the land of Ṭūs where he will be buried
key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, whose name this man shares
key_terms.الْفَتْحِ: the Victory, before which spending and fighting are especially meritorious
key_terms.بِالسَّمِّ: by poison, describing the cause of his killing
key_terms.خُرَاسَانَ: the region in which Ṭūs is located
key_terms.عَارِفًا بِحَقِّهِ: recognizing his rightful rank and claim
key_terms.غَرِيبًا: as a stranger, away from his homeland
key_terms.وُلْدِ مُوسَى: the descendants of Mūsā عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the Imam buried in Ṭūs while recognizing his right?
ai.summary: This hadith foretells a descendant of Mūsā عليه السلام bearing the name of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, who will be buried in Ṭūs in Khurāsān after being poisoned. It emphasizes the immense merit of visiting him with recognition of his rightful status, promising a reward comparable to those who gave and struggled before the conquest.
